facts.about: Tata Consultancy Services is the flagship company and a part of Tata group. It is an IT services, consulting and business solutions organization that has been partnering with many of the world's largest businesses in their transformation journeys for over 50 years. TCS offers a consulting-led, cognitive powered, integrated portfolio of business, technology and engineering services and solutions.

flags.text: Cash-rich profits: 5-yr operating cash = 101% of PAT

business.summary: TCS provides IT services, consulting, and business solutions, including application development, digital transformation, AI, and cloud services, to large global enterprises to support their transformational journeys.

segments.name: Banking, Financial Services and Insurance
segments.note: Largest industry vertical segment by revenue.

guidance.statement: We will work towards inching margins higher from here.
guidance.quote: As I mentioned, we'd look towards inching up from where we are, whilst not losing sight of prioritizing investments for growth.

guidance.statement: We want to exit at 25% plus and strive to achieve it sooner rather than later.
guidance.quote: We want to exit at 25% plus and strive to achieve it sooner rather than later.

guidance.statement: We would definitely target to have at least 1% of our employee base to work in the FDE model.
guidance.quote: But going forward, we would definitely target to have the definition that we come up with, and target to have at least 1% of our employee base, to work in the new operating model.

guidance.statement: We are also expecting a stronger 1H.
guidance.quote: We are also expecting a stronger 1H. Our planning assumption is along those lines only.

guidance.statement: We'd like to move towards 26%, but on a longer-term basis.
guidance.quote: We'd like to move towards 26%, but on a longer-term basis.

guidance.statement: We want to inch closer to our 26% to 28% band and we'll make all efforts to climb towards 26%.
guidance.quote: But irrespective of that, while we will not shy away from making investments, we want to inch closer to our 26% to 28% band and we'll make all efforts to climb towards 26%.

guidance.statement: We expect the ongoing impact to be minimal, around 10 to 15 basis points.
guidance.quote: We expect the ongoing impact to be minimal, around 10 to 15 basis points.

guidance.statement: We expect it to continue into the next quarter as well.
guidance.quote: And as communicated earlier, we expect it to continue into the next quarter as well.

scorecard.promised: Reach 26% to 28% band long-term; exit FY27 at 25%+.
scorecard.delivered: Operating margin reported at 26% in Jun 2026 and Sep 2026.
scorecard.evidence: Operating margins stayed flat at 26% in Jun 2026 and Sep 2026, holding within target parameters.

scorecard.delivered: Revenue hit ₹72,275 cr (+13.9% YoY) in Jun 2026 and ₹73,188 cr (+11.2% YoY) in Sep 2026.
scorecard.evidence: YoY growth accelerated significantly to 13.9% in Q1 FY27 and 11.2% in Q2 FY27.

scorecard.promised: Target at least 1% of employee base in FDE model.
scorecard.evidence: Requires verification of FDE headcount share in upcoming operating updates.

scorecard.promised: Ongoing labor impact expected around 10 to 15 bps next quarter onwards.
scorecard.delivered: Margins fell from 27% in Mar 2026 to 26% in Jun 2026.
scorecard.evidence: Margin compression of 100 bps observed between Mar 2026 (27%) and Jun 2026 (26%).

scorecard.promised: Restructuring expected to continue into Q4 FY26.
scorecard.evidence: PAT reached ₹13,784 cr in Mar 2026 with margins at 27%.

narrative.scoreline: Management successfully delivered strong H1 FY27 revenue acceleration while maintaining stable 26% operating margins.

narrativeVsNumbers.claim: AI revenue is growing across verticals and is margin accretive.
narrativeVsNumbers.reality: Operating margins remained flat at 26% in Q1 and Q2 FY27 versus 27% in Q4 FY26.

narrativeVsNumbers.claim: Growth momentum will continue into FY27 based on pipeline and order book.
narrativeVsNumbers.reality: Q1 FY27 revenue rose 13.9% YoY to ₹72,275 cr and Q2 FY27 grew 11.2% YoY to ₹73,188 cr.

narrativeVsNumbers.claim: Q1 FY27 margin drop of 130 bps driven primarily by annual increments.
narrativeVsNumbers.reality: Margin dropped 100 bps sequentially from 27% in Mar 2026 to 26% in Jun 2026.

bull: Revenue growth accelerated strong in H1 FY27, reaching 13.9% YoY in Jun 2026 and 11.2% in Sep 2026.
Excellent cash generation with 5-year operating cash reaching 101% of PAT (₹52,094 cr CFO in FY26).
Practically debt-free balance sheet with low debt-to-equity ratio of 0.10x.
bear: Operating margins have plateaued at 26% in FY27, below the upper target band of 28%.
Cash conversion cycle expanded to 93 days, up from 81 days three years ago.
Legal and tax overhangs exist including US$ 168 million trade secret lawsuit damages.
watch: Check if Q3 FY27 operating margin holds at 26% despite subcontracting costs.
Track cash conversion cycle trajectory from current 93 days level.
Verify whether H2 FY27 revenue growth matches 11%+ H1 run-rate.

claims.claim: We are confident that growth momentum will continue based on TCV, pipeline, and client conversations.
claims.quote: Sudheer, definitely, looking at all the parameters, I don't want to comment on the immediate next quarter basis, but on a medium-term basis, looking at the TCV, looking at the pipeline and the client conversations that we are having, we're confident that growth momentum will continue.

claims.claim: AI revenue is growing across every vertical and is accretive to company average margins.
claims.quote: On the first one, the $3.1 billion AI revenues which we have are coming in at a much higher margin than our company average.

claims.claim: Subcontracting costs, productivity, and utilization are key levers to reach our 26-28% margin aspiration.
claims.quote: Looking ahead, in terms of what are our levers available; subcon expenses, given the rate at which it has increased, definitely is one of the levers. Also, some of the investments will start to deliver results. That could be another lever.

claims.claim: We are prioritizing investments in AI and high-growth areas to build future capacity and capture demand.
claims.quote: As we build future capacity and navigate demand transitions, we have invested in a higher bench and increased hiring of subcontractors to meet near-term skills and delivery requirements.

claims.claim: We are generally optimistic that demand will resume in Q2 due to pent-up technology backlog.
claims.quote: I expect the demand to improve sometime in Q2. We're generally optimistic on Q2 going in at this time.

claims.claim: Productivity gains passed on to customers are typically in the 10% to 15% range.
claims.quote: One quantification I can give you is in most places, the productivity gain passed on is around 10% to 15% range.

claims.claim: The 130 bps sequential margin decline was primarily driven by annual wage hikes.
claims.quote: In Q1, we rolled out annual increments for our global workforce, which impacted margins by 170 bps.

claims.claim: Annualized AI revenues surpassed $2.3 billion in Q4, driven by accelerated deployment across industries.
claims.quote: In Q4, our annualized AI revenues surpassed $2.3 billion, driven by the accelerated deployment of AI solutions across industries.

claims.claim: Management believes margin and growth are not conflicting and high margins provide flexibility to invest for growth.
claims.quote: We don't believe these are at loggerheads with one another.

claims.claim: The restructuring program initiated by the company has been completed.
claims.quote: The program towards restructuring has been completed.

claims.claim: AI services generate US$1.8 billion in annualized revenue and is growing at 17.3% QoQ in constant currency.
claims.quote: Our AI services now generate US$1.8 billion in annualized revenue and is growing at 17.3% QoQ in constant currency.

claims.claim: BFSI will return to growth as deal momentum remains strong excluding seasonality.
claims.quote: But the overall deal momentum that we are seeing excluding the seasonality, the growth we saw in the accounts, gives us the confidence that BFSI will return to growth.

claims.claim: The current order book trajectory will help in growing in FY27 as well.
claims.quote: We believe this order book will help us in growing in FY '27 as well.

claims.claim: Build-out requires about 18 months post-anchor customer announcement, after which revenue should start.
claims.quote: Typically build out would require about 18 months, post which revenue should start ticking in.

risks.text: Intensifying global competition for specialized AI talent may increase attrition levels.
Clients may delay investments as they assess the impact of foundational AI models.
Company ordered to pay US$ 168 million in damages regarding trade secret misappropriation lawsuit.
Ongoing indirect tax disputes with authorities amounting to H646 crore.
